title: FY2025 revenue in the IM does not match the audited accounts
description: The information memorandum states FY2025 revenue of CHF 148.6 million; the audited income statement and the financial model show CHF 142.3 million. The CHF 6.3 million gap is not reconciled anywhere.

evidence.needle: Revenue reached CHF 148.6 million in FY2025
Income statement for the year ended 31 December 2025

title: Largest customer can terminate on change of control
description: Clause 14.2 of the Brenntal agreement lets the buyer terminate on 90 days' notice if a third party acquires more than 50% of the Supplier without consent. Brenntal is 31.2% of FY2025 revenue and the legal due diligence has not reviewed this agreement.

evidence.needle: more than 50% of the shares or voting

title: Net leverage covenant close to breach in FY2026
description: The model shows FY2026 net leverage of 4.38x against a 4.50x covenant, a headroom of 2.7%. A revenue shortfall of the size flagged in the chair's note would push the covenant close to breach.
